consoleSteps.title: Configure the CLI profile and create the helper files

instructions.text: Open Windows PowerShell.

jsonBlocks.content:
#!/bin/bash set -euxo pipefail dnf install -y httpd TOKEN=$(curl -sS -X PUT -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600" http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token) INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -sS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: ${TOKEN}" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id) AZ=$(curl -sS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: ${TOKEN}" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/placement/availability-zone) cat > /var/www/html/index.html < fa-lba

Availability Zone: ${AZ}

EOF echo "healthy" > /var/www/html/health systemctl enable httpd systemctl start httpd

tasks.goal: Allow public HTTP only to the ALB and backend HTTP only from the ALB security group.

instructions.text: Open EC2 > Security Groups.

Keep the default allow-all outbound rule.
Create fa-lba-web-sg in fa-lba-vpc.
Add inbound HTTP TCP 80 with Source set to fa-lba-alb-sg.
Do not add SSH.
Keep the default allow-all outbound rule.

tasks.goal: Create fa-lba-tg for instance targets on HTTP:80 with health path /health.

consoleSteps.title: Create the target group and /health health check
consoleSteps.instruction: Open EC2 > Target Groups > Create target group.

instructions.text: Open EC2 > Target Groups > Create target group.
Target type: Instances.
Name: fa-lba-tg.
Protocol HTTP, port 80, IPv4.
VPC: fa-lba-vpc.
Health check protocol HTTP.
Health check path /health.
Healthy threshold 2, unhealthy threshold 2, timeout 5 seconds, interval 30 seconds, success codes 200.
Do not manually register a target.
Create the target group.

consoleSteps.expectedResult: fa-lba-tg exists in fa-lba-vpc. HealthCheckPath is /health. No targets are registered yet.

cliSteps.expectedResult: fa-lba-tg exists in fa-lba-vpc. HealthCheckPath is /health. No targets are registered yet.

instructions.text: Open EC2 > Launch Templates > Create launch template.
Name: fa-lba-lt.

Delete the HTTP:80 listener on fa-lba-alb.
Delete fa-lba-alb and wait until it disappears.
Delete fa-lba-tg.
Delete fa-lba-web-sg, then fa-lba-alb-sg.
Remove both explicit subnet associations from fa-lba-public-rt.

Delete fa-lba-public-a.

Sign in as root only after cloud cleanup is verified.
Delete the fa-lba-admin access key.

Delete fa-lba-admin and sign out of root.
Remove only the fa-lba-admin CLI profile.
Delete C:\aws-labs\fa-lba last.
